A clean, bright daylight photograph of out-of-home advertising in a real city: Three identical small posters are pasted in a neat row on a long matte black painted hoarding beside a pavement; a simple metal bench stands in front.

The output is one single photograph, landscape 16:9.

Composition A, centred and symmetric: the design surface sits on the centre line, square to the camera, with even space on both sides; strong verticals and horizontals run parallel to the frame. Shot: Camera across the pavement at poster height, 50mm lens, f/8, square to the hoarding. The three posters sit side by side with even gaps, together filling about 55 percent of the frame width, the middle one on the centre line, all sharp; the low metal bench below them; a plain building and blue sky above the hoarding; hard sun and a crisp shadow line across the black. Nobody is in frame.

Place: A real city on a clear day: plain concrete, white render, old brick and steel; clean pavements; nothing else unless the shot names it.

Light: Clear, hard daylight from a high sun in a cloudless deep blue sky: crisp shadows with sharp edges, bright walls, natural contrast.

Palette and grade: Clean natural colour: a clear saturated-but-natural blue sky, true neutral whites, warm concrete and brick, deep clean shadows; the design surface pure neutral white. The same grade on every image of the collection.

Real: this is a product mockup photograph of out-of-home advertising, so the design surface is the hero: it is large in the frame and the camera is close enough that it dominates, never a tiny board in a wide view. It is an unstaged photograph of a real place on a real day, with the place clean and well kept, no dirt, grime, stains or graffiti; the design surface itself is new, flat and clean. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the objects named in the shot are in frame. The design surface is bright and clean without blowing out; its edges and corners stay crisp.

Design surface: EVERY POSTER IS PLAIN MATTE PAPER-WHITE, pasted flat with crisp edges, nothing printed on any of them.

Finish: Shot like clean architectural documentation on a medium-format digital camera: sharp, precise, straight verticals, fine detail, natural true colour, a light film-like softness in the highlights. Calm and considered, like the case-study photos of a top design studio; never a 3D render, never over-processed or HDR.

Avoid: a face, chin, lips or profile, logos, letters or brand names anywhere, any object not named in the shot, clouds, haze or a hazy sky, an HDR or over-saturated look, a clean smooth 3D render look, dirt, grime, stains or graffiti.
